goals:
• All IP addresses have been preconfigured for you.
• Configure IBGP within AS {{as1}} and AS {{as2}}.
  AS {{as1}}: {{router3_name}}, {{router4_name}}
  AS {{as2}}: {{router1_name}}, {{router2_name}}
• Configure EBGP between router {{router3_name}} and {{router1_name}}.
• Configure EBGP between router {{router4_name}} and {{router2_name}}.
• Advertise all physical interfaces in BGP.
• Advertise the loopback0 and loopback1 interfaces in BGP on all routers.
• Ensure you have full reachability, all physical interfaces and loopback interfaces should be reachable from any router.
• You are only allowed to use the weight attribute for the upcoming tasks.
• Configure router {{router3_name}} so traffic to {{router1_loopback0_network}} /{{router1_loopback0_prefix_len}} is sent to router {{router4_name}}.
• Configure router {{router1_name}} so traffic to {{router4_loopback0_network}} /{{router4_loopback0_prefix_len}} is sent to router {{router2_name}}.
• Configure router {{router2_name}} so traffic to {{router3_loopback1_network}} /{{router3_loopback1_prefix_len}} is sent to router {{router1_name}}.
